rules.name: recon-dup-08-branch-c-stored-vs-live
rules.sql: SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.trade_id, h.source_trade_id, h.security_id, h.asset_class::text AS asset_class, h.invenio_product_code::text AS invenio_product_code, h.product_name::text AS product_name, h.exchange_name::text AS exchange_name, h.lot_mult1::double precision AS lot_mult1, h.curr_mult1::double precision AS curr_mult1, h.mult_factor::double precision AS mult_factor, h.nc_factor::double precision AS nc_factor, h.fx_nc_factor::double precision AS fx_nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.trade_id, h.security_id, sp.asset_class::text AS asset_class, sp.invenio_product_code::text AS invenio_product_code, sp.product_name::text AS product_name, sp.exchange_name::text AS exchange_name, sp.lot_mult1::double precision AS lot_mult1, sp.curr_mult1::double precision AS curr_mult1, sp.mult_factor::double precision AS mult_factor, sp.nc_factor::double precision AS nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view sp ON sp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND sp.security_id = h.security_id AND sp.tenant_id = :tenant AND sp.security_id IN (:s.security_id[]) WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC') AND h.security_id IN (:s.security_id[])

SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.trade_id, h.security_id, fx.fx_nc_factor::double precision AS fx_nc_factor, fx.actual_fx_nc_factor::double precision AS actual_fx_nc_factor, (fx.actual_fx_nc_factor IS DISTINCT FROM fx.fx_nc_factor) AS actual_differs FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = h.source_trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

expect.reason: branch C BUs have published settle rows
stored product fields, multipliers and nc_factor equal what sp returns
stored fx_nc_factor equals what fx_nc_factor_view returns
INFORMATION: a failure means actual_fx_nc_factor differs from fx_nc_factor for some rows, so a stored actual_fx_nc_factor column is needed
